title: Service-Recovery Amount When Billing Continued After a Vision Plans Termination Request — Premium Billing Accounts
content:
**Rule.** A service-recovery amount is added to the termination credit of a vision plan unit on a Premium Billing Accounts arrangement when Cascade billed after it had the termination request on file. It is added after any deduction and after the floor at 0.00, and the credit is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**The request examined.** The confirmed voluntary-termination request on the Vision Plans records for the unit's subscriber enrollment, taken as the one registered last (of two registered at the same moment, the one recorded first). Its lead is the number of days from the day it was registered to the unit's termination date; it was registered "early" when that lead is at least the arrangement's invoice lead time, in days, and more than zero.

| Arrangement | Invoice lead time (days) |
|---|---|
| Cascade Individual Direct Bill Monthly | 20 |
| Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly | 20 |
| Cascade Individual Quarterly Bill | 30 |
| Cascade Individual Annual Prepay | 45 |
| Cascade Exchange SADP Monthly | 20 |
| Cascade Group List Bill | 30 |
| Cascade Group Self-Administered Bill | 0 |

**Months billed after the termination month** are the whole calendar months from the month after the month of the unit's termination date through the coverage month of the invoice issued last (of two issued on the same day, the one recorded first); zero when there is no invoice or that month is not later than the termination month.

**Tiers**
| Request registered early | Months billed after the termination month | Amount added |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 3 or more | 20.00 |
| yes | 1 or 2 | 10.00 |
| yes | 0 | nothing |
| no, or no confirmed request for that enrollment on record | any | nothing |

**Hypothetical cases** (Cascade Individual Quarterly Bill, lead time 30 days; termination date 30 September).
- Request registered 31 August (30 days before), invoice issued last for December: 3 months billed after September — 20.00.
- Same request, invoice issued last for October: 1 month — 10.00.
- Request registered 1 September (29 days before): not early — nothing.
